notes: warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "A Sudden Death is what you'll be giving unfortunate enemies with this shotgun! As the ONLY gun with the combo of Trench Barrel and One-Two Punch, definitely try to pick one up as the two perks do synergize quite well! Otherwise, the extremely rare combo of Discord and Redirection can rip and tear through minor and major enemies with ease (Though I have enjoyed Discord and Destab Rounds for general add-clear too)!" Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed.

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Aggressives are extremely lethal in PvP but suffer from poor stats (unfortunately, this one more than other end-game counterparts). That said, A Sudden Death does come with the battle-tested Slideshot + Opening Shot to boost those stats and accuracy. Alternatively, Threat Detector and Closing Time can be utilized too. Ultimately, this archetype has been overshadowed by Lightweights and Precisions in the Crucible." Recommended MW: Range or Handling.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 141 from 27 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/51wAzrVIRJRsBHGTMCLZ0n?si=fade7bb615184d3e) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Elites, Champions and Minibosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Aggressive frame shotguns maybe aren't the optimum for damage, but A Sudden Death has a couple of trait perk combinations that make it worth considering. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats aren't good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 24 Range equates to 4.48m before damage falloff, 26 Stability is ×1.1067 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 24 Handling is 0.46s ready, 0.40s ADS and 0.49s stow speed, and 32 Reload Speed is a 0.86s per shell reload. Recoil Direction is 74, and Zoom is 12, and Magazine size is 4 (max 6). With 0/1/2/3 Reserves mods, total ammo is 21/23/25/26 (max 27). Use the barrel perk to improve Handling, or close up pellet spread a little. In the magazine perk slot, Assault Mag improves RPM to 60RPM, or Tactical Mag plus Backup Mag increases the mag size to maximum. The unique roll to chase for burst DPS is the double damage trait perk combination of One-Two Punch, for ×2 direct contact melee damage within 1.22s after landing all 12 pellets (10 when enhanced) on target and Trench Barrel for ×1.5 damage (and +30 Handling and Reload Speed) for 5s or three shots. So punch, land three shots, punch, empty the magazine, punch, reload should see the end of most bulky mid-tier enemies. The Crossing Over origin trait is a little strange, providing extra range and handling in the top half of the mag, and a damage boost in the bottom starting at ×1.015 at 50% and ×1.03 with your penultimate and last shot, while Gravity Well can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "A Sudden Death is not a great shotgun for PvE, while you do have Envious Assassin and One-Two Punch which together allow you to never worry about reloading, I find rapid-fire frames at the opposite end of the shotgun spectrum better for One-Two Punch. Trench Barrel and Grave Robber are great combinations for “maining” this shotgun but an even better combination would be Destabilizing Rounds and Repulsor Brace, the issue with this combo is that it’s a shotgun and not a primary ammo weapon." Recommended MW: Range, Stability, Handling, or Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I used all my “creator” luck on my own personal Sudden Death, which I am very happy with. Threat Detector and Opening Shot are going to be the tried and true combinations. If you rock exotics like Ophidians, Dragon’s Shadow, or even Speedloader Slacks you can go with Slideshot, and those who love arc will love Elemental Capacitor. Opening Shot regardless of third column perk is still your best bet." Recommended MW: Range or Handling.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 97 from 13 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4Uy7pfo5Thjtt2MF4vZitv?si=8e3adcb68d234006) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Minor and Boss Spec enemies in end-game content. A Sudden Death returns as void, rather than arc shotgun with the rather poor stats you'd expect from a Year 1 gun. If you already have a burst damage void shotgun then feel free to pass as it's likely a fair bit better. If you are making do, then Barrel Shroud or Corkscrew Rifling pad out the Handling stats a little as the barrel perk, and Assault Mag speeds up shots, or Tactical Mag adds one to the mag as the magazine perk. You could take your choice of either Threat Detector's Handling and Reload buffs or Envious Assassin for an overflowed magazine to start an engagement with. Trench Barrel bumps up damage by 50% for three shots when procced - although you'll obviously need to be right up close to take advantage! The Crossing Over origin trait is useful all around for PvE, with bumps to range and handling in the top half of a magazine, and a small 3% damage boost at the bottom. Recommended MW: Handling, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.
